title: Power Apps: automatic loading and numbered pages in the modern Data Grid
summary: Hold: the briefing makes three unsupported assertions about changing Items: returning to the first page, clearing search, and clearing sort. Microsoft documents those effects for Pagination or PageSize changes, but describes Items changes as rebuilding the paging source; the licensing description and search guidance also need small corrections.

claims.claim: Built-in search over a partly loaded source can return incomplete results.

claims.where: Why it matters

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; What's changing; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The grid's Items formula supplies its data source; pagination does not introduce another data source.
claims.quote: **Items** – The data source for the grid. Accepts a Dataverse table, collection, or inline table expression.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Search normally checks loaded records; source-wide search uses DelegateSearch true and a delegable Items filter.
claims.quote:
1. Set **Searchable** to `true`.
2. Set **DelegateSearch** to `true`.
3. Use the grid's **SearchText** output in **Items** with a filter that your connector can delegate.
claims.fix: Replace the At rollout search bullet with: 'For source-wide search, have makers set Searchable and DelegateSearch to true, then use the grid's SearchText output in Items with a filter their connector can delegate.' Use that same qualification in the Data exposure bullet.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No pagination-specific licence, price, or meter is published in the documentation checked.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Data Grid Pagination licensing license meter canvas apps licensing. Read Data Grid, Power Apps licensing FAQs, and licensing/meter search excerpts; no pagination-specific licence, price, or meter was found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown because no pagination-specific licensing has been published.
claims.quote: Power Apps requires users to have an appropriate license to run apps, in alignment with the premium licensing requirements described in the Microsoft Power Platform Licensing Guide.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included' for this option inside an already licensed app. Replace the licensing notes, licensing paragraph and corresponding cost-rationale wording with: 'The app's existing Power Apps entitlement applies; Power Apps Premium is one published option. No pagination-specific licence, price or meter is documented at the time of writing (November 2026).' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/powerapps-licensing-faq and https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/powerapps-flow-licensing-faq#power-apps. Replace the licensing open question with: 'Will Microsoft publish an additional licence or meter for pagination?'
